NONE: › able or likely to change
可變的；會變的

example: the mutable nature of love
愛情的多變本質
Language is not static, it is mutable.
語言不是靜止，是會變化的。

NONE: › having the ability to cause a permanent change in an organism's genes
可導致基因發生永久性突變的
› an organism that is different from others of its type because of a permanent change in its genes
突變體
› disapproving an unpleasant and frightening thing
令人討厭的事物，可怕的事物

example: These mutants lack a vital protein which gives them immunity to the disease.
這些突變體缺乏一種可以抵抗這種疾病的重要蛋白質。
This mutant gene is thought to cause cancer.
人們認為這種突變基因會致癌。
figurative humorous I'm convinced he's a mutant - he's not at all like the rest of our family!
我覺得他真是個異類——他一點也不像我們家的其他人！
The result of these experiments will be a nightmarish world filled with two-headed monsters and other mutants.
這些實驗的結果將是一個噩夢般的世界，到處是雙頭怪和其他可怕的異形。

NONE: › to develop new physical characteristics because of a permanent change in the genes. These changes can happen naturally or can be produced by the use of chemicals or radiation.
（遺傳物質等）突變，變異
› to change from one thing or type of thing into another
轉變

example: These bacteria have mutated into forms that are resistant to certain drugs.
這些細菌已發生突變，對某些藥物產生了抗藥性。
Jon has mutated from an awkward teenager into a sophisticated young man.
約翰從一個稚嫩的少年變成了一個久經世故的年輕男子。

U: › [ U ] the way in which genes change and produce permanent differences
C: › [ C ] a permanent change in an organism, or the changed organism itself
（生物體的）突變，變異；突變生物體

example: It is well known that radiation can cause mutation.
眾所周知，輻射可以造成基因突變。
Environmental pressures encourage genes with certain mutations to persist and others to die out.
環境的影響使某些發生了若干突變的基因存活下來，卻使另一些消亡了。
These plants carry the mutation for red flowers.
這些植物攜帶紅花變種。

NONE: › silent or not speaking
沉默的；（活動）無聲的
› old-fashioned offensive unable to speak
無法說話的；（人）啞的
› music a device for changing the sound of a musical instrument, usually making it quieter
（樂器上的）弱音器
› also mute button a button on an electronic device that makes it silent
靜音按鈕
› old-fashioned offensive a person who is not able to speak
啞巴
› If you mute a noise, you do something to make it less loud.
減輕（噪音）
› music If you mute a musical instrument, you attach a device to it that changes its sound, usually making it quieter.
（給樂器）加弱音器

example: The president has remained mute about plans to curtail the number of immigrants.
總統對於減少外來移民人數的方案保持沉默。
I gazed at her in mute admiration.
我默默地凝視著她，心生愛慕之情。
a mute child
啞巴孩子
He was playing his trumpet with a mute.
他正在吹裝了弱音器的小號。
I pressed the mute on my phone so she couldn't hear the people talking in the background.
我按下手機上的靜音按鈕，這樣她就不會聽到背景中別人的說話聲了。
He was watching TV with the mute button on.
他正在按了靜音鍵看電視。
Heavy curtains muted the noise of the traffic.
厚厚的窗簾減低了交通噪音。
The song features muted trumpets.
這首歌的伴奏中用上了裝了弱音器的小號。

NONE: › the largest type of swan. Mute swans do not make as much noise as other swans when they fly.
啞天鵝；疣鼻天鵝
› not loud
（聲音）不響亮的，輕輕的
› showing little enthusiasm
缺乏熱情的，淡漠的
› A muted colour is not bright.
（顏色）柔和的，不耀眼的

example: There was polite, muted applause when I finished speaking.
我結束發言時，響起了禮貌而又溫和的掌聲。
The idea received a muted response.
這個想法反應平平。
She was dressed in muted shades of blue.
她身穿色調柔和的藍色衣服。

NONE: › medicine
藥品
› African traditional medicine, for example magic objects or medicines prepared from plants or animals
非洲傳統藥品（用植物和動物製成的藥品或魔法物件）
› to damage something severely, especially by violently removing a part
使殘缺不全；使傷殘
› to destroy an idea or a piece of art or entertainment
毀壞，使支離破碎

example: Her body had been mutilated beyond recognition.
她的屍體嚴重毀損，根本無法辨認。
Self-hatred apparently drove her to mutilate her own face.
顯然是自我憎恨驅使她自毀面容。
They have mutilated a beautiful film by making these changes.
他們的這些改動平白把一部好看的電影搞得支離破碎。

NONE: › someone who takes part in a mutiny
反叛者，叛變者
› an occasion when a group of people, especially soldiers or sailors, refuses to obey orders and/or attempts to take control from people in authority
（尤指士兵或船員的）叛亂，嘩變，暴動
› to take part in a mutiny
反叛，叛變；嘩變

example: Conditions on the ship were often very bad, and crews were on the point of mutiny.
船上的情況常常十分糟糕，船員隨時可能發動嘩變。
There were rumours of mutiny among the troops.
部隊裡有兵變的傳言。
Soldiers crushed mutinies in three jails.
士兵鎮壓了三個監獄的暴動。
The crew mutinied and murdered the ship's captain.
船員嘩變，殺害了船長。
The troops mutinied against their officers.
士兵反抗他們的長官。

C: › informal a person who behaves in a silly or careless way

example: Come on you mutts, play harder!
加把勁，你們這些笨蛋！

NONE: B2 to speak quietly and in a low voice that is not easy to hear, often when you are worried or complaining about something
嘟囔，咕噥

S: › [ S ] (the sound of) words being said very quietly

C: › [ C ] a complaint that is made to only a few people

example: Stop muttering and speak up!
別咕噥了，大聲說出來！
He was muttering (away) to himself.
他在喃喃自語。
Laurence muttered something about his wife and left.
勞倫斯低聲說了他妻子的甚麼事就離開了。
He muttered something under his breath to the person next to him.
他壓低聲音對他身邊的人咕噥了些甚麼。
I heard the soft mutter of voices in the next room.
我聽到隔壁有人輕聲低語。
There were mutters that other departments received more money than ours.
私下裡有人發牢騷說其他部門比我們部門拿的錢多。

NONE: › complaints that are made to only a few people
嘀咕，私下抱怨

example: There are mutterings of discontent among the staff.
員工中有人私下裡發牢騷。

NONE: › the meat from an adult sheep eaten as food
羊肉
› Indian English the meat from a goat or sheep eaten as food
羊肉，山羊肉
› a way of describing an older woman who is dressed in a style that is more suitable for a younger woman
扮俏（或裝嫩）的婦女

example: Do you think this dress is too young-looking for me? - I don't want to look like mutton dressed as lamb.
這條連身裙對我來說是不是太年輕了？我可不想裝嫩。

NONE: › long hair growing down each side of a man's face, fashionable especially in Europe and America in the 19th century
羊排絡腮鬍
C1 (of two or more people or groups) feeling the same emotion, or doing the same thing to or for each other
相互的，彼此的；共同的，共有的
› a financial organization that is owned by its members, rather than by shareholders
互惠機構（由成員而不是持股人擁有的金融機構）

example: Theirs was a partnership based on mutual respect, trust and understanding.
他們的合作是建立在互相尊重、信任和理解的基礎之上的。
Both countries are acting to their mutual advantage.
兩國的做法對彼此都有好處。
The agreement was terminated by mutual consent.
經雙方同意，這項協議被終止了。

NONE: C1 a person who is the friend of two people who may or may not know each other
共同的朋友

example: Lynn and Phil met through a mutual friend.
林恩和菲爾是透過他們共同的朋友認識的。

NONE: › a service where financial experts invest the money of many people in many different companies
共同基金，互惠基金
› a relationship between two organisms in which they live together and benefit each other
互助主義
› felt or done by two or more people or groups in the same way
互相地

example: It will be a mutually beneficial project.
這將是一項互利的計劃。
Being rich and being a Socialist are not mutually exclusive (= they can exist together at the same time).
身為富人和身為社會主義者並不相互排斥。
